cards.text: The prophet Malachi has been speaking to the people about breaking faith with one another (Malachi 2:10). Then comes this: "You have wearied the LORD with your words…" and the people fire right back, "How have we wearied Him?" That's the coworker who talks through the WHOLE meeting, then asks why it ran so long.

cards.question: The people ask how they've wearied the LORD with their words. What's one thing they've been saying?

answers.text: Evildoers are good in His sight
The prophets don't speak for Him

cards.text: Their other line? "Where is the God of justice?" That's me with my face pressed to the oven door every ten seconds, yelling WHERE ARE MY COOKIES.

cards.question: Then the LORD of Hosts speaks up. What does He say He will send?
The LORD of Hosts says He will send His messenger. What will the messenger do?

answers.text: Guard the doors of His temple

cards.text: Mark it down, friend. "…see, He is coming," says the LORD of Hosts.

cards.question: The Lord the people seek will come to His temple suddenly.
The LORD of Hosts speaks of the Messenger of the covenant as someone the people delight in.

cards.text: They've been seeking Him, but then the hard question hits: "But who can endure the day of His coming?" That's the guy at the gym yelling BRING ME THE HEAVY WEIGHTS, and when somebody brings them, he's suddenly VERY into stretching.

cards.question: Then comes the question of who can stand when the Lord appears. Why will it be so hard?

answers.text: He'll be like a refiner's fire
He'll come with a great army
He'll shake the earth and sky

cards.text: He'll also be like a launderer's soap. Then the picture gets specific: He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver.

cards.question: The Lord will sit as a refiner of silver. He will purify the sons of ___ and refine them like gold and silver.
After the Lord refines the sons of Levi, they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
After the refining, the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will ___ the LORD, as in days of old.

cards.text: Then the LORD of Hosts says, "Then I will draw near to you for judgment." He will be a witness against sorcerers, adulterers, perjurers and those who oppress the widowed and fatherless.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts says He will be a slow witness against sorcerers, adulterers and perjurers.
The LORD names who He'll be a witness against. Which of these people is also on His list?

answers.text: Those who cheat workers of their wages
Those who skip the yearly feasts
Those who eat food that is unclean

cards.question: The LORD's list ends with those who deny justice to the foreigner but do not ___ Him.
